# Project knowledge and tooling (area `project`)

Docs, licences, agent instructions, this kb registry and gate, and historical spikes.

Active decisions here. Run `tools/kb/run kb show <file>` for the ones governing one file, their tests and open work; never reword an owner decision (supersede it).

- **PROJ-500** (owner): Examples, copy and tests in tracked files use invented data only; nothing personal to the owner is committed. Personal parts live in local untracked files (kb/local/).
- **PROJ-501** (owner): The repo has no CHANGELOG.md. Release notes, if any, are a new decision.
- **PROJ-502** (owner): After a UI edit an agent may build and relaunch the development build and the playground; relaunching the installed FERB.app needs the owner's OK.
- **PROJ-503** (owner): FERB is licensed Apache-2.0 (LICENSE, pyproject.toml).
- **PROJ-504** (owner): THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md keeps the license attributions for bundled third-party code.
- **PROJ-505** (owner): When an older decision disagrees with code the owner has tested, the code stands: the decision is superseded by one that states what the code does. A decision the owner made after the code (e.g. MEM-35) is built instead.
- **PROJ-506** (owner): FERB targets macOS (FERB.app) and phone companions on iPhone and Android. There is no Windows port: the windows branch and its work were deleted on 2026-11-03, and no Windows code, tasks or decisions are kept. A Windows version again would be a new owner decision.
- **PROJ-507** (owner): main is fast-forwarded to ui/ux (no merge, no rewrite) and is the branch agents commit and push to from now on (AGENTS.md "Branch"). ui/ux stays as it is; nothing is deleted.
- **PROJ-508** (owner): The conversion to Rust is built on branch rust (main stays as it is until the rewrite is merged). The goal is the Rust engine working with the Mac, iPhone and Android apps. Method, order, toolchain and machine set-up for the rewrite are the agent's to decide without asking. The agent keeps a journal (rust/JOURNAL.md) of what was done and why.
- **PROJ-509** (agent): kb/config.toml `historical` lists {commit, paths, why}. A decision's or area's path that names nothing tracked now, but files under one of those paths at that commit, is checked there (a ::symbol in that file's text then). Anything tracked now is judged on the current tree only. The commit must resolve and paths can't be empty. `kb show` names the commit a path was removed at. Records keep their paths as written.
- **PROJ-510** (owner): The Rust engine is in engine/ (crates, fixtures, packaging) with the runtime files (prompts, memory notes, abilities, migrations, the helper's source) in engine/runtime/; the apps in apps/ (apps/mac is FERB.app; apps/android and apps/ios for stages 3 and 4); the browser extension in extension/. kb/, scripts/, tools/, assets/, site/ and relay/ stay. One mechanical move: FERB.app's contents and run-time paths unchanged; kb records keep their words.
- **PROJ-511** (agent): kb/config.toml `moved` lists {from, to, why}. A record's path that names nothing tracked now is read at its place under `to` (longest `from` wins), then in `historical`. kb show for a file at its new place lists the records naming its old place; generated rules use new places. A `to` must exist and never move again (no chain or cycle). Records keep their paths as written.
- **PROJ-512** (agent): For PROJ-510. extensions/store (the Chrome Web Store listing and its artwork) is extension-store/, beside extension/, so extension/ holds only the unpacked extension that is zipped and loaded. ui/ moved whole to apps/: apps/AGENTS.md, apps/docs, apps/output and apps/.gitignore with apps/mac.
